title: Clients' telemetry
description: Whether the telemetry of users' clients reaches the stores: how the batches that the telemetry proxy takes end, how many bytes it forwards, and what the collector refuses or fails to pass on of them. And what the clients measured of their own requests (the client_telemetry spec).

panels.title: How do the clients' batches end?
panels.description: The batches that the telemetry proxy's three routes answered in the last 5 minutes, by status and error code: 200 for a batch that the collector took, 403 client_telemetry.consent_required for a user who doesn't consent, 429 request.rate_limited for a rate limit or a budget, and 400 client_telemetry.batch_refused or 503 client_telemetry.collector_unavailable for a batch that the collector refused or didn't take (CLIENT_TELEMETRY-004 to CLIENT_TELEMETRY-010). "Which rate limits refuse requests?" on the API platform dashboard tells a user's budget from a replica's.

targets.expr: sum by (http_response_status_code, error_type) ((increase(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{http_route=~"/v1/users/me/telemetry/(traces|logs|metrics)"}[5m]) and http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{http_route=~"/v1/users/me/telemetry/(traces|logs|metrics)"} offset 5m) or (http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{http_route=~"/v1/users/me/telemetry/(traces|logs|metrics)"} unless http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{http_route=~"/v1/users/me/telemetry/(traces|logs|metrics)"} offset 5m))

panels.title: How many bytes of clients' telemetry does each replica forward a minute?
panels.description: The bytes a minute, inflated, of the batches that the collector took from each replica, over the last 5 minutes. A replica's budget, CLIENT_TELEMETRY_REPLICA_BYTES_PER_MINUTE, bounds what it forwards in each of the budget's windows of a minute (CLIENT_TELEMETRY-008).

panels.title: How many bytes of each signal does the collector take from the replicas a minute?
panels.description: The bytes a minute, inflated, of the batches that the collector took from every replica together, by signal, over the last 5 minutes (CLIENT_TELEMETRY-013). Tempo and Loki take in no more of the clients' spans and log records than those batches hold, since the collector drops what its configuration doesn't list. Of the clients' metrics, Prometheus stores the series that the collector adds up, at each scrape, whatever bytes their batches held.

panels.title: Is the collector refusing or failing to pass on the clients' telemetry?
panels.description: Items in the last 5 minutes that the collector's receiver of clients' batches refused, as when the memory limit of the clients' pipelines is reached, which the telemetry proxy answers with 503, and items that the clients' exporters failed to send to their stores.

targets.expr: sum by (exporter) ((increase(otelcol_exporter_send_failed_spans_total{exporter=~".+clients"}[5m]) and otelcol_exporter_send_failed_spans_total{exporter=~".+clients"} offset 5m) or (otelcol_exporter_send_failed_spans_total{exporter=~".+clients"} unless otelcol_exporter_send_failed_spans_total{exporter=~".+clients"} offset 5m))

sum by (exporter) ((increase(otelcol_exporter_send_failed_log_records_total{exporter=~".+clients"}[5m]) and otelcol_exporter_send_failed_log_records_total{exporter=~".+clients"} offset 5m) or (otelcol_exporter_send_failed_log_records_total{exporter=~".+clients"} unless otelcol_exporter_send_failed_log_records_total{exporter=~".+clients"} offset 5m))

sum by (exporter) ((increase(otelcol_exporter_send_failed_metric_points_total{exporter=~".+clients"}[5m]) and otelcol_exporter_send_failed_metric_points_total{exporter=~".+clients"} offset 5m) or (otelcol_exporter_send_failed_metric_points_total{exporter=~".+clients"} unless otelcol_exporter_send_failed_metric_points_total{exporter=~".+clients"} offset 5m))

panels.title: How do the clients' requests end?
panels.description: The requests that users' clients measured, in the last 5 minutes, added up over every installation, by client, by the response's status, and, for a request that got none, by error_type: timeout, connection_error, or _OTHER for any other (CLIENT_TELEMETRY-014, CLIENT_TELEMETRY-015). A client reports these numbers itself, so they inform, and no alert reads them.

targets.expr: sum by (job, http_response_status_code, error_type) ((increase(http_client_request_duration_seconds_count[5m]) and http_client_request_duration_seconds_count offset 5m) or (http_client_request_duration_seconds_count unless http_client_request_duration_seconds_count offset 5m))

panels.title: How long do the clients wait for their requests?
panels.description: How long the typical request and the slowest one in a hundred took, as users' clients measured them, over every installation and the last 5 minutes, by client (CLIENT_TELEMETRY-014).

panels.title: Which points of the clients' metrics does the collector leave out of its sums?
panels.description: Points of the clients' metrics in the last 5 minutes that the collector didn't add to a series, by why: limit, for a point of a series beyond the most that the collector adds up, or the error of a point whose time isn't after its series' last one.

targets.expr: sum by (error) ((increase(otelcol_deltatocumulative_datapoints_total{error!=""}[5m]) and otelcol_deltatocumulative_datapoints_total{error!=""} offset 5m) or (otelcol_deltatocumulative_datapoints_total{error!=""} unless otelcol_deltatocumulative_datapoints_total{error!=""} offset 5m))
